name: Sulazepam
summary: Sulazepam is a benzodiazepine derivative. It is the thioamide derivative of diazepam. It is metabolised into diazepam, desmethyldiazepam and oxydiazepam. It has sedative, muscle relaxant, hypnotic, anticonvulsant and anxiolytic properties like those of other benzodiazepines. It was never marketed.

pharmacology.text: It is metabolised into diazepam, desmethyldiazepam and oxydiazepam.

uses.en: It was never marketed and is known only as a research compound.
uses.zh: 它從未上市，只作為研究用化合物為人所知。
uses.zhHans: 它从未上市，只作为研究用化合物为人所知。

sideEffects.en: Because the body turns it into diazepam, it would be expected to act like diazepam. Drugs of its class, the benzodiazepines, can cause drowsiness, poor coordination, memory problems and dependence, and stopping after regular use can bring a dangerous withdrawal with seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 由於身體會把它轉換成地西泮，預期其作用與地西泮相似。苯二氮平類藥物可能造成嗜睡、協調變差、記憶問題與依賴，長期使用後突然停藥可能出現危險的戒斷反應，包括癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 由于身体会把它转换成地西泮，预期其作用与地西泮相似。苯二氮平类药物可能造成嗜睡、协调制差、记忆问题与依赖，长期使用后突然停药可能出现危险的戒断反应，包括癫痫发作。

fact.en: It is the thioamide version of diazepam: a sulphur atom takes the place of one oxygen atom, and the body converts it back into diazepam.
fact.zh: 它是地西泮（煩寧）的硫代醯胺版本：用一個硫原子取代了一個氧原子，而身體會把它轉換回地西泮。
fact.zhHans: 它是地西泮（烦宁）的硫代酰胺版本：用一个硫原子取代了一个氧原子，而身体会把它转换回地西泮。
